"19) Gonna wrap this up for the moment with the most important piece of advice I have: very few stream channels will become overnight sensations. Be prepared to put work into your channel, your stream, and more importantly yourself if you want to succeed. 20/20"

"18)Dont try to imitate popular streamers. If I wanted to watch someone that streamed like my favorite big streamer, Id tune in to watch their stream. If I tune in to your stream, I want to watch YOU. If youre similar to streamer X, thats fine but dont actively try to imitate 19/?"

"17) If you have a stream bot that links your social media info or reminds viewers to sub/follow/donate, set it to only post X amount of time after someone says something in your chat. Nothing is worse than watching a stream where the chat is only filled with bot posts. 18/?"

"16) If you stream X game, browse other smaller streams that also stream that game. Join their chat and make friends with them. Its a good way to network and at the very least you'll make new friends that enjoy that game. Networking is important to growth 17/?"

"15)If you have social media accounts for your channel on twitter, snapchat, or instagram dont just post only when youre going live. Post funny memes, cool clips from your stream, food/animal/etc pics. If your post feed is just "I'm now live" & 30 hashtags its not helping you 16/?"

"14) When trying to grow your channel, dont go into your favorite big time streamers channels and advertise that your stream. Its super rude and most big channels have rules against it. Its likely to get you banned from that channel and accomplishes nothing. 15/?"

"13) If you're trying to be a professional streamer, watch your language! I dont mean dont curse. Curse as much as you want. I mean dont use hateful langauge or throw racial slurs around. That will turn away new viewers so fast. Soon as I hear that in a new stream I nope out 14/?"

"12) Stream the kind of games you enjoy playing! If you only stream new and popular games that you dont like much, it shows. Playing an old game that you love and cherish is more entertaining to streamers than watching you be terrible at a new release. 13/?"

"11) Titles are important especially if you are a newer streamer. You dont need to put a million words in your title but if you just list the game youre playing, that wont attract viewers. Is it a first playthrough? Speed run? Game with friends? That info belongs in the title 12/?"

"10 Follow for follow streamers are never a good growth option. You want new followers who will tune in to your stream and help you grow. 10 followers who doesn't watch your stream are worth less than one follower who tunes in regularly and chats. 11/?"

"9) If you're a new streamer, please dont have a million links for people to donate to you. Have 1 link in your profile and dont bombard people with donation requests. New viewers want to watch you stream, not feel like they're watching a donation drive. 10/?"
